title: LiarsLounge
description: Deceive friends, expose liars, and survive the ultimate mind game in Minecraft.
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93a23ed031f076b4ea1493c2d7736cb8ec61ed23.png)
Step into the ultimate game of bluffing, betrayal, and survival - **right inside Minecraft!** Inspired by the popular Steam game _LiarsBar_, LiarsLounge brings deception, strategy, and chaos to your server. Gather around the lounge table, play your cards, and try not to lose your head... literally. Whether it’s a small party or a big network, this plugin is designed to keep players hooked with laughter, suspicion, and mind games that never get old. ![features_title_img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0dd649014518f67b2902d7d4cd63c14221b1978.webp) - GUI, Book UI, Holograms & Titles visualization. - Smooth card throws, flips, and axe strike animations. - Host multiple games at once with full **multi-arena** support. - Real-time scoreboard system. - **Fully editable** messages, titles, scoreboards, inventory menu & book ui. - Every game item, material, skin texture are editable using the config. - [Quick setup](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lcb4W1bzFnY) with hologram guides showing you where to place chairs and items. - Optimized for 1.8.8 & 1.20.5+. - Built with async systems, animations, scoreboards, and packets run off-thread for a lag-free experience. - MySQL (for remote db) & SQLite (for local db) Support. - [PlaceholderAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/placeholderapi) & [PartyAndFriends](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/party-and-friends-extended-for-spigot-supports-1-7-26-1.11633/) Integration.
⬡ REQUIREMENTS: SpigotMC/PaperMC 1.8.8 or PaperMC 1.20.5+ with Java 11+ ⬡
![media_title_img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3d9be784ced90bba19348edcd149177ca683d40.webp) #### GAMEPLAY VIDEO ### SCOREBOARD ![scoreboard_img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9ce615505b6c336cfccca9334f7b8629aab021a.webp) ### GUI ![arena_selector_gui](https://github.com/aarcorrea/LiarsLounge/blob/main/media/gui-1.gif?raw=true) ![bookandquill_gui](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d02686af5c3c1ac37731ba70f6ec0e7cd8af3a06.jpeg) #### TABLE CARD ![table_card_animation](https://github.com/aarcorrea/LiarsLounge/blob/main/media/table-card.gif?raw=true) #### CARD THROW ![card_throw_animation](https://github.com/aarcorrea/LiarsLounge/blob/main/media/card-throw.gif?raw=true) #### LIAR REVEAL ![liar_reveal_animation](https://github.com/aarcorrea/LiarsLounge/blob/main/media/liar-reveal.gif?raw=true) #### LIAR CAUGHT ![liar_caught_animation](https://github.com/aarcorrea/LiarsLounge/blob/main/media/liar-caught.gif?raw=true) #### GAME OVER ![game_over_animation](https://github.com/aarcorrea/LiarsLounge/blob/main/media/game-over.gif?raw=true) #### EXTRAS ##### 1. Players/Spectators never see what cards others are holding, instead they see a placeholder card ![player_holding_card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6acaa3547aca5e02b6a53542ec2fe641b3931071.webp) ##### 2. The highlighted player in scoreboard indicates whos turn it is ![scoreboard_currentplayer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0898df7f1b14433ad397e8864dba3170f31b136a.webp) ##### 3. The Expereince bar is used as a time limit for the player to play their cards & the hearts display remaining lives (chance of survival) for the player ![expbar_countdown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/427a25085c26a299933ddfe67e612e1e46ae4be0.gif) ##### 4. Each player see the cards facing towards them (Client-Side Magic) ![cards_on_table](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03ce2165135ceca24430f9e99e90e4ad8211ab31.webp) ##### 5. Remaining lives can be easily seen above a player ![player_hearts_hologram](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c02181b58ecfd99a773befb71ff04023bd1aa408.webp) ![gameplay_overview_title_img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/641f56f4f97a1aacb365e5b927b4803fc8704473.webp) 1. Players gather in a waiting lobby. The game begins once enough players join. 2. Everyone is teleported to seats around the lounge table. 3. Each player receives 5 cards plus a “Call Liar” item. 4. A table card is revealed to everyone. 5. On your turn: either play a card (Click + Q) or accuse the previous player. 6. If the liar is exposed, they face the Axe with 6 lives and a shrinking chance to survive. 7. If the call is wrong, the accuser faces the Axe instead. 8. After each execution, cards are reset and a new table card is revealed. 9. The cycle continues until only one survivor remains. ![contact_title_img](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a660767948b38db4bb7fa753b04a0fa152ef58d6.webp) Have questions, suggestions, or found an issue?
